fieldNotes.truckGate: Large 51-acre plant fully enclosed by a tall iron perimeter fence (confirmed on all sides in 2024/2025 Street View). Vehicle entrance off Dannon Way has a kerbed checkpoint island in the driveway - controlled entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly visible freestanding guard booth beside the truck lane in available imagery; entrance area is cluttered with staged construction/expansion material. Marked false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated, fenced entrance with no confirmed guard booth - remote/kiosk check-in inferred. Flagged uncertain alongside guardShack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large dock apron on the east/SE building face with ~30 doors estimated and many trailers backed in; honest overhead estimate, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard in the SE with rows of parked trailers - 50+ stalls. Heavy freight operation, 24/7 plant.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access road wraps from the Dannon Way entrance around the east side to the dock yard - ample queue depth for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and broad internal roadways with unused paved width - room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot in the SE, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; rail line in the broader district does not serve this plant.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain - a scale could be present in the dock-yard area but not confirmed from overhead.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing block plus an attached/adjacent large warehouse section - counted as 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: West Jordan industrial district in the Salt Lake City metro - Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Roster cites 51.17-acre site; perimeter box drawn to encompass the full parcel including the southern undeveloped portion.

citations.claim: Danone North America's own locations page lists this plant at "6165 West Dannon Way West Jordan, UT 84081". Our roster address for this record is "6165 West Dannon Way, West Jordan, UT 84081", which matches at street level, and the record's coordinates were geocoded from that address.

divestitureCheck.method: Danone's own locations page is its current operating list, so presence on it is positive evidence the plant is still running. Cross-checked against the 2026 restructuring, which named Bridgeton NJ as the closure and named Mount Crawford, Dallas and Jacksonville as receiving its volume.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the current company locations page; not closed or divested

sources.covers: the 2026 Danone North America manufacturing restructuring and the single US plant closure it produced

verification.claimScope: address-level identity from the operator's own published facility list, plus a geocode of that address. Not an independent parcel survey.
verification.rationale: CONFIRMED: Danone North America publishes this plant on its own locations page with a full street address, and that address matches this record's roster address at street level. The record's coordinates were geocoded from that same address. Identity is therefore address-level from the operator itself; it is not an independent parcel survey. The same page is the operating-status check: it is Danone's current facility list, and the only one of our 13 published Danone sites missing from it is Bridgeton NJ, which Danone closed on 2026-08-02.
